elements.name: Watch room
elements.about: The duty officer takes emergency calls here and sends crews out; the station's nerve centre.

elements.about: Air cylinders are refilled and masks cleaned and tested after every call.

elements.about: Blast suits for bomb disposal.

elements.about: Robots and kit.
